query_evidence.question: ORACLE B4 for scenarios Q18
query_evidence.sql:
WITH resolved_sessions AS (SELECT s.session_id, s.session_started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.platform, s.country_at_event,
       COALESCE(s.user_id,
                (SELECT MIN(l.user_id) FROM identity_links l
                 WHERE l.session_id = s.session_id
                 GROUP BY l.session_id
                 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) = 1)) AS resolved_user_id
FROM sessions s),
m(month, ms, me) AS (VALUES ('2026-08','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-09','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z','2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'))
SELECT m.month, r.platform,
  COUNT(*) AS all_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.resolved_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identified_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.session_started_at >= m.ms THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS started_in_month
FROM m JOIN resolved_sessions r ON r.session_started_at < m.me AND r.last_activity_at >= m.ms
GROUP BY m.month, r.platform ORDER BY m.month, r.platform
